effect: An effect is something that is caused by something else.
His comments had a visible effect on those who heard it.
If a law, agreement, change, etc. takes effect, it officially begins.
The closing of the company takes effect at midnight.
A sound effect is a way to make a sound for a performance artificially.
The used a lot of normal materials to create the sound effects for the show.
A special effect is a way to make an image for a performance artificially.
They didn't really cut his hand off, but the special effect made it look real.
If you effect a change, you make it happen.
I will effect the change without your help.
effective: An effective strategy, treatment, method, etc is one that works well as planned.
Teachers are using instructional strategies that are most effective in helping students learn.
If you have effective command, consent, control, etc., you have it in practice but not officially.
The students had effective control over what the teacher would include on the test.
If a law, agreement, change, etc. becomes effective, it officially begins.
The new rules about ball size are effective next season.
You use effective to tell when something starts officially.
Effective next week, all employees will wear the new uniform.
effort: The amount of work that is done on something.
A great amount of effort was put into this event; we had over 4,000 visitors.
effortless: When something is effortless, it does not need effort.
Please help me with these boxes. It is an effortless task, it will only take a few minutes.
effortlessly: If you do something effortlessly, you do it without effort or difficulty.
After studying for three weeks, the student completed the exam effortlessly.
efficient: If something is efficient, it can do a lot but uses very little time, energy, money, etc.
He wastes a lot of time talking, and isn't very efficient at work.
effeminacy: Effeminacy is the feminine traits displayed by a human male.
effrontery: Effrontery is behavior which is boldly rude.
I was highly offended by his effrontery.
effectively: If something is done effectively, it is done in a way that is effective.
efficiency: Efficiency is the state or quality of being efficient.
Efficiencies are steps that can be taken to make things more efficient.
effloresce: If something effloresce, it loses moisture and turn to a fine powder when exposed to air.
If something effloresce, it reaches an optimum stage of development.
efficacy: Efficacy is the ability to produce a effect or result that is desired.
efficiently: If something is done efficiently, it is done in an efficient manner.
effectiveness: The effectiveness of something is defined as how effective it is.
The effectiveness of this treatment is 75%.
effeminate: If a man is effeminate they behave like a female.
effectless: If something that was done is effectless, its outcome does not have an effect or advantage.
